Which of the following statements regarding the Yield Curve is FALSE ?
options: An inverted yield curve is often considered a predictor of recession.
A normal yield curve is upward sloping.
The yield curve plots the relationship between interest rates and default risk.
The yield curve plots the relationship between interest rates and time to maturity.
questions.correct_answer: The yield curve plots the relationship between interest rates and default risk.
